endorsements.quote: As such, clinicians must ardently maintain their scepticism and critical thinking and serve as a stopgap to guard against spurious results and bias.

unlisted_practices: Sports medicine stakeholders should collaborate and share data to aggregate datasets large enough to develop and validate clinically useful injury prediction models.
Ensure that stakeholders, including athletes, have a role in stewardship of aggregated sports medicine datasets.
Establish clinical readiness of AI through clinical trials, with randomized controlled trials as the definitive standard.
Validate AI models for generalizability through external validation on reserved data or independent datasets.
Apply explainable AI techniques such as saliency maps in sports science AI to reduce black-box opacity.
Use retrieval-augmented generation to restrict LLM knowledge to pre-specified source material such as clinical guidelines.
Use time reclaimed by AI efficiency gains to enhance patient-centered human care rather than replace clinicians.

screen.reason: This is a comment/perspective article evaluating the clinical readiness, ethical challenges, and governance needs of AI in sports medicine.
